import hashlib
import os

def generate_password_recovery_token(user_data):
    email = user_data.get('email')
    if not email:
        return False
    
    salt = os.urandom(16)
    hashed_email = hashlib.pbkdf2_hmac('sha256', email.encode(), salt, 100000)
    
    user_data['reset_password_code'] = salt + hashed_email
    
    return True
